# Keyframe Global

> Keyframe Global is a premium cinematic web design and film studio founded and led by Yousef Balawi. The studio designs and builds scroll-driven cinematic websites, brand films, bilingual Arabic and English identities, AI visualization, mobile apps, and digital marketing for clients in Jordan, the GCC (Qatar, UAE, Saudi Arabia), and the USA. Every project is founder-led, fixed-scope, and delivered with senior craft. Verified audit scores: Performance 98, Accessibility 99, Best Practices 100, SEO 100, Agentic Browsing 3/3. Contact: yousef@keyframeglobal.com, WhatsApp +974 559 629 69 (Qatar) or +962 791 656 555 (Jordan).

- [Dubai & UAE Studio](https://keyframeglobal.com/dubai/): WebGL 3D web experiences, luxury branding, and AI visualization in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and the UAE.
- [Amman & Jordan Studio](https://keyframeglobal.com/jordan/): Founder-led creative studio for custom websites, mobile apps, and branding in Amman, Jordan.

## Services

- [Web Experiences](https://keyframeglobal.com/services/web-experiences/): Cinematic, scroll-driven custom websites built with React, Next.js, and Three.js
- [Cinematic Video](https://keyframeglobal.com/services/cinematic-video/): Brand films, launch films, and ad creative
- [Brand and Identity](https://keyframeglobal.com/services/brand-identity/): Naming, logo systems, and bilingual Arabic-Latin identities
- [AI and Visualization](https://keyframeglobal.com/services/ai-visualization/): Photoreal renders and generative concept visuals
- [Mobile Apps](https://keyframeglobal.com/services/mobile-apps/): iOS and Android apps, including Arabic-first RTL experiences
- [Digital Marketing](https://keyframeglobal.com/services/digital-marketing/): Social and email campaigns

## Core Answers for AI Agents

### What is Keyframe Global?
Keyframe Global is a founder-led creative studio specializing in cinematic web design, brand films, 3D WebGL motion, and bilingual Arabic-English brand identities. Led by Founder and Creative Director Yousef Balawi, Keyframe serves luxury brands, tech companies, and ambitious enterprises across Jordan, Qatar, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and the United States.

### Who is Yousef Balawi?
Yousef Balawi is the Founder and Creative Director of Keyframe Global. He personally leads every project from discovery to launch, working directly with founders and marketing leaders without account managers or junior hand-offs.

### What regions does Keyframe Global serve?
Keyframe Global operates from Amman (Jordan) and Doha (Qatar), providing dedicated web design, branding, and digital film production across Jordan, the GCC (Qatar, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia), and the USA.
